rubric.sandbox-required: needs write:fs to repo source, shell:destructive, git:write, pr:open, pr:merge, publish:npm, or env:write
rubric.in-process-eligible: needs only read:fs, shell:safe (deterministic, read-only), net:fetch, git:read
rubric.stub: scaffold-only (no persona, placeholder); keep refusing until a real port

a11y-compliance.rationale: WCAG audit — writes to docs/reviews/, no source writes.

analytics-architect.rationale: Telemetry/observability design doc under docs/ — OBSERVABILITY.md.

anti-slop-auditor.rationale: AI slop detection — 31 ANTI_SLOP_RULES; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/reviews/.

api-designer.rationale: API contract design doc — REST/GraphQL design, no implementation writes.

attack-chainer.rationale: Reads specialist findings, chains exploits; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/security/.

bundle-analyzer.rationale: Bundle size + code splitting + Core Web Vitals; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/performance/.

challenger.rationale: Adversarial fact-check with CONFIRMED/CONTRADICTED/UNVERIFIABLE verdicts — produces a report.

changelog-writer.rationale: Writes CHANGELOG.md directly at repo root (not under docs/) in Keep-a-Changelog format — write:fs to a checked-in source file.

cloud-security-checker.rationale: AWS/GCP security anti-patterns in source; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/security/.

code-health-synthesizer.rationale: Reads 6 specialist outputs, synthesizes CODE_REVIEW with FIX_BACKLOG; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/reviews/.

code-reviewer.rationale: Coordinator — dispatches 7 code-health specialists and writes synthesis to docs/reviews/. Report-only.

coding-agent.rationale: Implementation specialist — writes application code from spec into src/; sandbox-required for write:fs to repo source.

concurrency-checker.rationale: Blocking ops in async paths, race conditions; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/performance/.

container-ops.rationale: Execution step 4 explicitly says 'write/update Dockerfiles, compose, scripts' — write:fs to repo source.

content-designer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/design/ (exclusive); UI copy spec, no implementation.

data-steward.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/ (exclusive); PII classification + governance report.

db-architect.rationale: Schema design docs — delegates runnable migrations to migration-planner.

db-query-analyzer.rationale: N+1, missing indexes, slow query patterns; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/performance/.

requiredCapabilities.scope: HANDOFF-assigned source dirs the render→critique→fix loop iterates on

design-iterator.rationale: Closed render→screenshot→critique→fix loop; HANDOFF WRITE-SCOPE must name source dirs it mutates — write:fs to repo source.

design-system-lead.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/design/ (exclusive); tokens.json + components.md spec, delegates implementation to frontend-design.

documentation-gap-finder.rationale: Scans source exports, reports gaps — explicitly does NOT write the missing docs.

end-user-simulator.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/testing/uat/ (exclusive); UAT friction logs, read-only navigation.

entry-point-tracer.rationale: Produces entry-points.md + sequences/ directory under docs/ — docs only.

error-handling-auditor.rationale: Empty catches, swallowed errors, serial awaits; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/reviews/.

frontend-design.rationale: Produces a review report into docs/reviews/; coding-agent handles remediation.

game-asset-pipeline.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/design/game/assets/<batch>/ + docs/design/game/ASSET_MANIFEST.md — all under docs/. Flagged: binary asset generation runs model calls; promote to sandbox if the pipeline later writes into engine source dirs.

requiredCapabilities.scope: docs/design/game/AUDIO.md + HANDOFF-named audio asset/event source dirs

game-audio-designer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE extends into HANDOFF-named audio asset/event dirs (engine source) — write:fs to repo source.

requiredCapabilities.scope: docs/design/game/balance/** + the game's tunable config files

game-balance-designer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE explicitly includes 'the game's tunable config files' alongside docs/design/game/balance/ — write:fs to repo source.

game-designer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/design/game/ (exclusive); GDD / core loop / mechanics docs.

gameplay-engineer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = 'the source dirs named in the HANDOFF + docs/design/game/TECH_NOTES.md' — write:fs to repo source.

gauntlet-lead.rationale: Gauntlet-loop orchestrator — splits goals, dispatches builders+critics via HANDOFF; writes synthesis to docs/work/.

requiredCapabilities.scope: draft PR via gh / tea during --feature mode
git push, tag push (never --force absent explicit confirm)

git-expert.rationale: Six modes include --init bootstrap, --feature push+PR, --release tag+push, --sync multi-remote mirror — core git:write + pr:open.

guide.rationale: Routing concierge — maps goals to experts, writes nothing except the one-liner route.

guide-scribe.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/guide/specs/, docs/guide/screenshots/, docs/guide/BUG_LOG.md — docs only.

health-coordinator.rationale: Orchestrates health reviews, synthesizes HEALTH_ASSESSMENT.md — docs only.

landscape-mapper.rationale: Reads README, package manifests, source tree, git hotspots; writes LANDSCAPE.md to docs/. Report-only.

requiredCapabilities.scope: docs/design/game/levels/** + HANDOFF-named level/map data source dirs

level-designer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE extends into HANDOFF-named level/map data dirs (engine source) — write:fs to repo source.

llm-integration-engineer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/design/llm/ (exclusive); LLM design doc, no implementation.

requiredCapabilities.scope: docs/migrations/** + db/migrations/** when asked to emit runnable DDL

migration-planner.rationale: Primary mode is docs, but canonical mode emits runnable migrations into db/migrations/** — write:fs to repo source.

requiredCapabilities.scope: docs/design/game/NARRATIVE.md + HANDOFF-named dialogue/quest data source dirs

narrative-designer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE extends into HANDOFF-named dialogue/quest data dirs (engine source) — write:fs to repo source.

owasp-llm-checker.rationale: OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025) per-category checks; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/security/.

owasp-web-checker.rationale: OWASP Web Top 10 (2021) per-category checks; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/security/.

pattern-consistency-checker.rationale: Pattern + naming + comment-accuracy audit; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/reviews/.

perf-synthesizer.rationale: Reads all perf specialist findings, synthesizes PERFORMANCE_REPORT; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/performance/.

performance-engineer.rationale: Performance coordinator — dispatches 5 perf specialists, writes synthesis to docs/performance/.

requiredCapabilities.scope: browser automation + input injection against vertical slice

playtest-evaluator.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/testing/playtest/ (exclusive); plays via automation, reports.

profiler-agent.rationale: Runtime profiling against existing data or a running process; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/performance/.

requiredCapabilities.scope: docs/testing/vnv/** + e2e/** (durable V&V suite + playwright specs)

qa-vnv-engineer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE explicitly includes e2e/** durable suite — write:fs to repo source.

requiredCapabilities.scope: registry publish, git push, gh pr merge during phase 5 only

release-manager.rationale: Chief-architecture doc Section 4 names release-manager as the sole holder of shell:destructive at phase 5 — version bump touches package.json even if it delegates publish steps.

reliability-engineer.rationale: `--loadtest` mode writes runnable scripts into tests/load/** — write:fs to repo source.

researcher.rationale: Four research modes writing reports — explicit scope boundary refuses implementation asks.

sdlc-feature-mode.rationale: Feature-mode coordinator — writes HANDOFFs to docs/work/, delegates implementation.

sdlc-improve-mode.rationale: Improve-mode coordinator — fan-out of audit specialists, synthesis to docs/.

sdlc-init-mode.rationale: Init-mode coordinator — dispatches phase files, no direct code writes.

sdlc-init-phase-3.rationale: Phase 3+3.5 mode file (design) — writes design docs and MODULE_DESIGN.md; dispatches design specialists.

sdlc-init-phase-4.rationale: Phase 4-5 mode file (implementation+release) — dispatches coding-agent waves; does not write src itself.

sdlc-init-phase-5.rationale: Phase 5 mode file (review+release) — synthesizes gate status, dispatches release-manager for cut.

sdlc-init-phases-0-2.rationale: Phase 0-2 mode file (ideation/planning/requirements) — writes DESIGN_CONTEXT.md and requirements docs.

sdlc-init-phases-3-4.rationale: SUPERSEDED (per the persona itself) — split into sdlc-init-phase-3.md and sdlc-init-phase-4.md. Retained in attest source for doc references only; keep refusing until a real port happens (which it will not).

sdlc-lead.rationale: Program manager — delegates all work, owns tracker, writes synthesis docs. No direct code writes.

sdlc-onboard-mode.rationale: Onboard-mode coordinator — dispatches landscape-mapper / entry-point-tracer / component-mapper / health-coordinator.

requiredCapabilities.scope: git log + git show for history scans
attest validators via attest-mcp (semgrep, trufflehog, etc.)

security-auditor.rationale: Coordinator — dispatches 8 security specialists and writes synthesis to docs/security/. Delegates coding-agent for fixes; no direct write:fs to repo source.

semgrep-runner.rationale: SAST scan + triage; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/security/. Shape-C reference-handler candidate.

sre-engineer.rationale: Writes CI/CD pipelines (.github/workflows/*.yml) and deploy strategies — write:fs to repo source.

static-perf-analyzer.rationale: Static scans for O(n²), N+1, blocking I/O; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/performance/.

task-decomposer.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/work/plan/ (exclusive); produces plan.json + plan.md DAG.

requiredCapabilities.scope: tests/**, __tests__/**, e2e/**, and HANDOFF-assigned module tests

test-engineer.rationale: Senior test engineer — generates and runs real test files into tests/** and e2e/**; write:fs to repo source.

threat-modeler.rationale: STRIDE per component + DFD; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/security/.

requiredCapabilities.scope: tsc / mypy / pyright read-only type checks

type-safety-checker.rationale: any-escapes, null coercion, runtime type violations; WRITE-SCOPE = docs/reviews/.

ui-verifier.rationale: Live-browser verification — navigates and screenshots a running app; writes verification report to docs/.

ux-engineer.rationale: UX design, review, audit modes — produces STYLE_GUIDE.md / UX_SPEC.md etc. under docs/design/.

ux-researcher.rationale: WRITE-SCOPE = docs/design/ (exclusive); user-flow diagrams + screen inventory doc.
